features.name: Linked Environments for Dataverse Integration
features.description: Capability for admins to link a specific Business Central environment only with a specific Dataverse environment, ensuring data safety and security within privacy boundaries.

features.name: Table Mappings for Existing Integration Tables
features.description: Ability to add new table mappings to existing integration tables by defining synchronization direction, filters, and configuration templates that apply when data moves between Business Central and Dataverse.
caveats: Cannot remap or duplicate existing integration table mappings as these are defined in code
Existing table mappings cannot be customized
field mappings are inserted as disabled by default
affects existing integration table mappings that may have running jobs

features.name: Field Mappings Configuration
features.description: Capability to add field mappings to new or existing integration table mappings by specifying transformation rules, validation rules, and application conditions.
caveats: Developer assistance required for lookup field mappings or additional custom logic
Supports most simple data types but not complex types without developer help
field mappings are inserted as disabled by default

features.name: Integration Troubleshooting Fact Box
features.description: New troubleshooting fact box in table integration mappings that enables admins to quickly identify and mitigate synchronization issues without reviewing extensive logs.

features.name: Company and Environment Copy Cleanup
features.description: Improvement to copy company and copy environment operations to properly clean up synchronization data, preventing erroneous coupling status and synchronization errors from source company.

features.name: Dataverse Connection Setup Page Rename
features.description: Connection setup pages have been renamed for clarity: Dynamics 365 connection setup renamed to Dynamics 365 sales integration setup, with separate setup for field service integration.
caveats: Pages still searchable via Tell Me with original names

features.name: Synthetic Relationships
features.description: Capability to create relationships between synchronized tables and virtual tables from Business Central APIs in Dataverse without requiring developers to customize and add to synchronized data.
caveats: requires virtual tables to be enabled
requires virtual table API page configuration
Requires proper configuration of relationships between tables

features.name: Data Sync Overview
features.description: Data synchronization capability that replicates data changes when data is created, updated, or deleted between overlapping tables in Business Central and Dataverse.

features.name: Virtual Tables
features.description: Virtual table capability that enables inbound interaction from Dataverse into Business Central using a Business Central API but without duplicating data.
caveats: requires virtual tables to be enabled
Requires BC configuration app installation
Mapping table needs to be created for app-level overrides

features.name: Data Change Events
features.description: Outbound notification capability from Business Central to notify other Dataverse apps of data changes, enabling scenarios like starting Power Automate flows with when a row is added modified or deleted trigger.
caveats: Flows require proper trigger configuration for different event types

features.name: Business Events
features.description: Outbound notification capability from Business Central to notify that actions are performed, enabling other Dataverse apps to react using Power Automate when an action is performed trigger.

features.name: Multi-company Support for Virtual Tables via Global Company Settings
features.description: Global company settings that apply to all users and all apps accessing virtual tables, providing a standard company context for Dataverse environments that lack a company concept.
caveats: global setting applies to all users and apps uniformly

features.name: User-specific Company Settings for Virtual Tables
features.description: User-level company settings that override global company settings, allowing individual users to target different companies across all apps and portals they use.
caveats: applies uniformly to all apps and portals for a single user

features.name: Dataverse Shared BC Company ID Execution Variable
features.description: New execution variable introduced in wave 1 that allows virtual table plugins to override both global and user-specific company settings for specific combinations of users, apps, and portals.
caveats: requires custom mapping plugin and mapping table to implement

features.name: Mapping Plugins and Tables for Company Targeting
features.description: Custom Dataverse plugins and tables that intercept virtual table API requests and dynamically set the BC Company ID shared variable based on combinations of user, app, and portal, enabling granular multi-company access control.
caveats: requires plugin registration using plugin registration tool
requires custom code development
example code will be published after launch event
requires documentation for Dataverse plugins

features.name: Business Events UI Pages for Troubleshooting
features.description: New UI pages added in 24 Wave 1 release for troubleshooting and monitoring business events, showing subscriptions and sent notifications with activity logs.

features.name: Enhanced Custom Dimensions for Partner Telemetry
features.description: Business events now send additional information in custom dimensions for partner telemetry in Application Insights, including event name and version.
caveats: Requires Application Insights setup in admin center

features.name: Business Event Subscription Page
features.description: New Business Event Subscription page shows subscribed events, notification history, activity logs, and retry information for monitoring event delivery and troubleshooting.

features.name: Partner Telemetry via Application Insights
features.description: Business events can be logged to Azure Application Insights with custom dimensions containing event metadata, enabling partners to query and monitor event streams in real-time.
caveats: Requires Application Insights setup with telemetry string in admin center
